summary.motive: Force the defense to shift gap fits and rotate secondary coverage laterally before/at snap, creating perimeter numbers advantages.
summary.whyItWorks: Jet motion pulls the cornerback wide and forces safety rotation, while the wide zone offensive line track washes the interior defensive front.
summary.failureMode: A blitzing nickel or safety shooting into the backfield to blow up the double-mesh timing before the handoff.

beats.title: 1. Jet Motion Forces Defense to Declare
beats.text: Z-receiver runs full sprint across the backfield. The defense is forced to rotate safeties and bump linebackers laterally before the snap, compromising their gap integrity.

beats.title: 2. The Double-Mesh Sequencing
beats.text: The QB executes a quick jet fake to Z before handing off to the RB on wide zone. This hesitation completely freezes the Mike and holds the defensive end.

beats.title: 3. Perimeter Overload & Crack Block
beats.text: Because jet motion widened the cornerback, the X receiver easily executes an inside crack block on the Will linebacker, creating a massive perimeter highway.

beats.title: 4. Explosive Edge Gain
beats.text: The running back bounces untouched around the perimeter for a dominant chunk gain.

relations.tell: Z-receiver runs full-speed jet motion across the formation before/at snap, creating a 2nd mesh point in the backfield.
